rationale.conceptual: Running DFT geometry optimizations and binding energy calculations with standard functionals and basis sets is a textbook operation in computational chemistry, requiring no custom algorithms or deep new theory.
rationale.execution: The workflow involves constructing crown ether geometries (S4, D3d conformations), generating NWChem input files, running 9+ separate DFT jobs (geometry optimization + single-point for complexes and fragments), extracting energies and bond lengths from output files, and compiling a CSV. This multi-stage pipeline with coordination of several large quantum-chemical calculations and data extraction is moderately complex.
